label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf): alert-TP — resolved sink value is http://<user-host>/v1 constructed from param=request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest'). Although there is a pre-check calling isNonPublicAddress(resolveHost(host)), this only blocks known private/reserved IPs and does not prevent DNS rebinding attacks, IPv6 bypasses, or future DNS redirection to internal resources. The user-controlled host parameter flows directly into the URL construction at line 43 without proper validation of the resolved destination. This is a classic SSRF vulnerability where an attacker can specify arbitrary hostnames to probe internal services.

evidence.note: User input captured: param = request.getParameter("BenchmarkTest"); host = param;
SSRF sink: URL constructed with user host and connected without validating resolved destination; isNonPublicAddress check insufficient against DNS rebinding
